obligations.statement: The clamp must attach the monitor arm to the desk edge.
derivation_premises: If the clamp does not fix the monitor arm to the desk edge, the monitor arm is not supported.

obligations.statement: The clamp must accommodate desk edge thicknesses from 18 to 40 mm.
derivation_premises: If the clamp cannot adapt to the full range of edge thicknesses, it will not fit on some desks.

obligations.statement: The clamp must not slip or rotate on the desk edge when the weight of the monitor arm is applied after tightening.
derivation_premises: If the clamp slips or rotates under load, it fails to hold the monitor arm in place.

obligations.statement: The clamp must be operable without tools for removal and relocation.
derivation_premises: If the user cannot attach/detach the clamp without tools, the tool-free requirement is not satisfied.

obligations.statement: The clamp must be able to grip the desk edge with a force sufficient to prevent slipping and rotation under the weight of the arm.
derivation_premises: If the gripping force is insufficient, the clamp will slip or rotate under load.

obligations.statement: The clamp must provide a manual interface for the user to tighten and loosen it without tools.
derivation_premises: If there is no manual interface, the user cannot operate the clamp without tools.

obligations.statement: The clamp must be able to be fixed to the desk edge without requiring access to the underside or hidden areas.
derivation_premises: If the clamp requires access that the desk edge does not provide, installation is impossible.

load_cases.applied_to_role: the surface of the desk edge

candidates.summary: A clamp with a lever-operated cam mechanism that directly grips the desk edge.

evidence_route_verdict.note: The cam lever must generate sufficient clamping force; dynamics can estimate forces.

candidates.summary: A clamp that uses a screw mechanism with a knurled knob to tighten against the desk edge.

evidence_route_verdict.note: The screw can be modeled as a helical joint to estimate required torque and resulting clamp force.

candidates.summary: A clamp that uses a sliding wedge mechanism activated by a lever to wedge against the desk edge.

evidence_route_verdict.note: The wedge can be analyzed using quasi-static force balance.

assumptions.statement: The desk edge is horizontal and has a uniform thickness within the stated range.
assumptions.why: The requirements state a range of thicknesses, implying a typical desk edge with consistent geometry.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the desk edge is not horizontal or has varying thickness.

assumptions.statement: The monitor arm has a standard mounting interface.
assumptions.why: The request refers to 'a monitor arm' without defining its attachment interface.
assumptions.would_be_invalidated_by: If the monitor arm uses a non-standard interface.
